Formula Baked offsets (distance d, angle a): d = minimumRadius + radiusIncrement*k, a = angularResolution*j, row shift round(sin a * d), column shift round(cos a * d), rounding half to even, samples edge-clamped at (row - rowShift, column - columnShift). rise = verticalExaggeration*(z_c - z_s) + observerHeight; offsets with rise > 0 (an invalid sample gives NaN, which never passes) add rise * (2d + radiusIncrement)/d. D = sum / (observerHeight * N) with N = sum over offsets of (2d + radiusIncrement)/d, so a flat surface scores 1. Invalid samples stay in N; an invalid centre gives NaN. Pixel units: no cell size.
